title: The Top 10 Lies I Told As A Pastor - And Didn't Even Realize It

top_liked.author: @xxlionroarxxxxxxxx4438
top_liked.text: Prayed every night for my 8 and 5 year old daughters to be safe and then my 5 year old died suddenly from thyroid storm and had Christian’s tell me my faith wasn’t strong enough is why my daughter died.I left religion and Christianity after that and never looked back

top_liked.author: @DeveloperChris
top_liked.text: As a Christian I was taught how to lie. Not to others but to myself. Once you learn how to lie to yourself, lying to others comes easy.

top_liked.author: @Explodington
top_liked.text: I think "nothing works like prayer" is pretty accurate. Doing nothing works exactly the same as saying a prayer. It's just faster.

top_liked.author: @scottstollery2191
top_liked.text: Unfortunately, I believed all 10 of those lies until my mid-20's, and walking away led to estrangement from family (haven't spoken to my mom in 20+ years), loss of friends and loss of identity. I don't think I intellectually grappled my way out of evangelical christianity back…

top_liked.author: @Drewbius333
top_liked.text:
I had a friend who repeatedly told me, often with a sick smile on his face, that I "send myself to hell".
Yet he wonders why I will have nothing to do with him and what he calls "love".

top_liked.author: @gleanerman2195
top_liked.text: As an ex-christian, nothing does my heart better than to hear an ex-preacher tell others that it's all a big fat lie.

top_liked.author: @boochi7087
top_liked.text: Subscribed! As a black woman who is agnostic atheist (agnostic to the universe and beyond, and atheist to the religious beliefs of the world/earth), I genuinely believe that we don't have adequate representation of black people talking about deconstructing religion, especially…

top_liked.author: @samuelschick8813
top_liked.text:
Christians: " God gave us free will."
Also Christians: " God has a plan for you."
Also Christians: " Nothing happens unless God planned it."
Me: " So God does not allow free will."

top_liked.author: @mikeking5626
top_liked.text: "Faith is the last line of defense when religion runs out of excuses." Well said, we shouldn't see blind obedience in spite of evidence as a virtue.

top_liked.author: @MrNess7783
top_liked.text: Walking away was the most liberating feeling in my life.
